326e910.summary: Fires death-related ability triggers for a dying minion (this-unit or other-unit death, unstable), then triggers extra abilities depending on how it died.

326ea70.summary: Picks the normal or alternative active ability based on board criteria, then plays each of its ability logics with pooled ability data.

326eb68.summary: Returns the card's alternative active ability or its normal one, depending on whether the board criteria are met.
